spec.title: Order and Nping Latency from IP

spec.query:
SELECT median("latency") 
FROM "default_defi_retention"."binance_latency_from_ip" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval), "destination"::tag 
fill(null)

SELECT median("latency") 
FROM "default_defi_retention"."binance_nping_latency" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval), "destination"::tag 
fill(null)

spec.title: 20 modifies vs 1 new limit order
spec.description:
Script sends 21 requests every 10 seconds, 20 out of the 21 are modify request (of the same order) and the remaining one is a new limit order to Binance fapi. 

Note that data points before 29 September 2023, 3:30pm UK time are incorrect as I had an error in the Modify requests. Data points since 29 September 2023 3:30pm UK time are valid.
